title: One-take market walk
prompt: A single continuous steadicam take through a morning fish market: start on ice crates of silver fish, glide past a vendor shouting prices, weave between customers, rise up a short staircase and end on a balcony looking down over the whole hall. Wet floors reflect the light. Constant market chatter, a bell rings near the end.
tip: Script the path in stages (start, pass, rise, end) so a 30-second take has somewhere to go.

title: Lighthouse from dusk to dark
prompt: Locked-off wide shot of a lighthouse on a rocky point as dusk turns to night: the sky shifts from orange to deep blue, the beam starts turning, waves break white on the rocks, the first stars appear. Steady surf, wind, a distant foghorn twice.
tip: A locked camera and one slow change (light) is the safest use of a long duration.

title: Train window journey
prompt: View from a train window: fields, a river, a small village and a tunnel pass by; in the tunnel the glass shows the reflection of a woman reading, then daylight returns over the sea. Rhythmic rail clatter, a page turning.
tip: A reflection beat in the middle breaks a long travelling shot without a cut.

title: Bread from dough to loaf
prompt: Top-down on a floured wooden table: hands knead a ball of dough, shape it, score the top with a blade, then the loaf sits golden and cracked on the same spot. Kneading thumps, a knife swish, the crackle of a fresh crust.
tip: Process videos read well top-down: the frame stays fixed while the object changes.

title: Cheap long draft
prompt: Vertical timelapse-style shot of a busy crosswalk from above: waves of pedestrians and umbrellas cross as the light changes from green to red several times, a cyclist weaves through at the end. City noise, crossing signal beeps.
tip: Judge pacing at 480p ($1.14 for 30 s) before rendering 1080p.

title: Mascot in three places at once
prompt: @Image 1 waves on the beach from @Image 2, then the camera whips to the same mascot building a snowman on the street from @Image 3. Upbeat whistling, waves, then crunchy snow.
tip: One character image plus one image per location keeps the mascot identical across places.

title: Product hero on Prime
prompt: @Image 1 stands on a wet black stone as water droplets bounce off it in slow motion, the camera tilts up from the base to the cap. Cold blue light, droplets ticking, a low hum.
tip: Prime accepts 16:9, 1:1 or 9:16 only; this vertical hero fits a story ad.

title: Two references, one handshake
prompt: In a bright glass office, @Image 1 stands up from the desk and shakes hands with @Image 2, who just walked in; both smile and sit down. Light keyboard noise, a door closing.
tip: Give each person an action of their own so the two references do not blend.

title: Pet in a costume
prompt: @Image 1 wears the hat from @Image 2 and proudly trots across a sandy beach toward the camera, tail wagging, waves behind. Paws on sand, gulls, a cheerful accordion tune.
tip: The seed lets you change only the prompt wording and compare like for like.

title: Product photo to motion
prompt: The camera slowly orbits the product while soft light glides across its surface; everything else in the photo stays still. Quiet studio air.
tip: adaptive keeps the photo's own framing; a fixed ratio would crop it.

title: Portrait to cinemagraph
prompt: Only the hair and the scarf move in a light breeze; the face stays still, eyes blink once. Subtle, looping feel.
tip: Silent output suits a cinemagraph that will play muted in a feed.

title: Landscape photo, vertical crop
prompt: Clouds roll over the mountains and the lake ripples as the camera tilts slowly from the shore up to the peaks. Wind and water lapping.
tip: On wan-3 a fixed ratio with a first frame crops the photo, here to vertical.

title: Concept art to opening shot
frames: a concept painting of a floating city
prompt: The camera pushes in through drifting clouds toward the floating city as airships cross in front of it and lights flicker on in the towers. Deep wind, distant engines, a rising string note.
tip: Concept art makes a strong first frame for a title sequence.

title: Before and after renovation
prompt: Walls repaint themselves, the old floor peels away into new oak, furniture slides into place and lamps switch on. Quick construction sounds that settle into calm.
tip: Both photos must be taken from the same spot for a clean morph.

title: Seasons in one tree
frames: the same tree in full autumn color
prompt: Snow melts, buds open into green leaves, summer light passes, and the leaves turn red and gold. Birdsong rises and fades with the seasons.
tip: 16:9 here crops both frames to widescreen; use adaptive to keep their shape.

title: Character turnaround
prompt: The character turns slowly on the spot, a full half turn, arms relaxed. Plain studio background, no sound but a soft footstep.
tip: Turnarounds help when you build a character sheet for later reference jobs.

title: Day footage to night
prompt: Turn the scene into night: street lamps and shop signs glow, the sky is dark blue, wet asphalt reflects the lights. Keep the people, their movement and the camera move unchanged.
tip: State what must stay unchanged; the edit keeps the clip's length and ratio.

title: Swap one object
prompt: Replace the parked red car with the car from @Image 1, matching the lighting and reflections. Everything else stays as it is.
tip: In an edit @Video 1 is the clip being edited; extra references keep their own numbers.

title: Live action to watercolor
prompt: Restyle the whole clip as a loose watercolor painting with visible paper texture and soft bleeding edges, keeping every movement and cut timing the same.
tip: Style edits bill the source twice: 10 s source = 20 billed seconds.

title: Remove the crowd
prompt: Remove all the people in the background so the plaza is empty; keep the fountain, the pigeons and the camera move.
tip: Short sources keep edits cheap while you test the instruction.

title: New sky, same shot
prompt: Replace the flat grey sky with a dramatic sunset of orange and violet clouds and warm the light on the buildings to match. No other changes.
tip: Silent output avoids replacing the clip's original sound when you remux later.

title: Visualize a podcast line
prompt: An animated chalkboard illustrates the story told in @Audio 1: simple drawings appear in sync with each idea, a hand sketching quickly.
tip: On wan-3 audio may be the only reference; Prime would need an image or video too.

title: Abstract shapes to a beat
prompt: Bold geometric shapes pulse, split and recombine on every hit of @Audio 1, bright primary colors on black.
tip: 480p keeps music visualizer drafts under $0.31 for 8 s.

title: Singer from a photo and a track
prompt: @Image 1 sings @Audio 1 into a vintage microphone in a smoky jazz club, lips in sync, warm spotlight, slow push-in.
tip: Audio references are free; only the 12 output seconds are billed.

title: Storyboard frame in motion
prompt: A detective in a trench coat steps out of a taxi into heavy rain, looks up at a neon motel sign and pulls his hat down. Rain hiss, taxi door slam.
tip: Prime's faster turnaround suits blocking out a scene; 5 s at 480p is $0.255.

title: Square social loop
prompt: A cup of matcha is whisked into a bright green foam in a ceramic bowl, top view, a final swirl. Bamboo whisk sounds.
tip: 1:1 is one of Prime's three ratios.

title: Vertical teaser with a reference clip
prompt: @Image 1 runs up a spiral staircase toward the light at the top, the camera moving like @Video 1. Echoing footsteps, heavy breathing.
tip: 8 output seconds + 4 reference seconds = 12 billed seconds on Prime.

title: Widescreen establishing shot
prompt: Aerial shot over a coastal town at sunrise, fishing boats leaving the harbor in a line. Gulls, distant engines.
tip: Prime's minimum is 4 s; Wan 3.0 goes down to 2 s.

title: Website hero background
prompt: Slow drifting macro of ink clouds blooming in clear water, deep blue and teal, very calm motion, no objects.
tip: generate_audio false gives a silent file ready for an autoplay background.

title: Fireplace ambience
prompt: Static close shot of logs burning in a stone fireplace, flames licking upward, embers glowing and falling. Warm, steady, hypnotic.
tip: Add your own crackle track later; the price is the same with or without sound.

title: Slide deck backdrop
prompt: Soft gradient light leaks in amber and rose drift slowly across a dark background, gentle bokeh, nothing in focus.
tip: Keep backdrops low in contrast so slide text stays readable over them.

title: Same seed, three lenses
prompt: A red vintage scooter parked on a cobblestone street in Rome at noon, a cat walks past it. Shot on a 24 mm wide lens. Vespa idle, church bells.
tip: Rerun with the same seed changing only the lens (24 mm, 50 mm, 85 mm) to compare framing.

title: Lock a look, change the weather
prompt: A lone hiker stands on a ridge looking over a valley, light rain falling, mist in the trees. Raindrops on the jacket, distant thunder.
tip: Keep the seed and swap 'light rain' for 'clear sunset' to get a matching pair.
